from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsReceivable(BaseModel):
    """One company's accounts receivable from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company's name, as written in the document")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities code if provided, e.g., '301058'")
    accounts_receivable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The accounts receivable ending balance in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt showing the accounts receivable figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_accounts_receivable: list[CompanyAccountsReceivable]
